Book now for after the freeze

One page lets a founder book a date after Black Friday, and the offer stays as it is.

The idea

A founder sees an ad that offers a date after the Black Friday rush, not a call about starting this week. On one page they pick a 15 minute December call that walks through their own Black Friday numbers, or a 15 minute January call that holds the week their first A/B test launches. You get calls booked now from founders who would otherwise say "after BFCM" and wait.

Hypothesis

Founders may not book a call now because of Black Friday, Cyber Monday and the holidays, so this funnel asks them to book a date after the rush instead of a start this week. It is wrong if $480 spent on ads to new audiences brings no booking from a store doing $150k a month or more by Mon 7 Dec, or if fewer than 4 such calls are booked by Fri 11 Dec.

Cost

Media $1,000 to $1,260; build 16 to 26 hours. Est.

Run it

You run every step below. Warm ads go to people who already visited your pages; cold ads go to new people. Two ways to start: warm ads from Thu 19 Nov, only if the Mon 16 Nov go holds, or everything from Wed 2 Dec, the default. Orange rows are go or no go points and stop rules.

This funnel sends no cold message. Emails and WhatsApp messages go only to founders who booked a call. Uploading your GHL contacts to Meta as a customer list waits on a legal read of the lawful basis, and nothing goes to Danish prospects by message until you name your countries and have that legal read.

Every number here is directional: the budgets are sized to reach the keep and stop counts, not to forecast results. Your VSL v3 ads and this funnel's ads run in the same auction from Wed 2 to Fri 11 Dec, so read both with that in mind.

Ads

Every ad promises both choices, matching the page. Meta button labels are fixed options; "Book now" is the one used.

How to useLink every ad to https://new.purplefire.io/after-freeze/v1?utm_source=meta&utm_campaign=f02_after_freeze&utm_content={ad name}. Keep the ad names as written here: "warm" or "cold" in the name tells the page which audience the booking came from (warm: people who already visited your pages; cold: new people).

How to useEach "Image led version" below runs as a second ad in the same ad set as its type led original, with the same copy, so Meta shows which one earns the click.

Landing page

The first screen is the choice. Pick a card, a December day or a January week to open the booking step under the cards. The standalone file for your developer is landing-02.html.

How to useOn landing-02.html, ?board=demo shows 2, 1 and 0 seats left with a full December day, ?board=decfull shows December full, and ?today=2026-12-02 shows the lines that change from Wed 2 Dec. Without them the page shows the slot board as set: 2 seats left in each January week.

Forms and calendars work on the page and send nothing.

    Your first split test is on us. You pay after the first win.

    1. We research the test, design it and build it on a duplicate theme. You approve the design before it launches.

    2. A win is a variant that lifts revenue by at least 5 percent over 7 days at 88 percent significance or higher. Only then does the winning variant go live for all your traffic.

    3. No card on file until the first winner. On the call we tell you what you pay after the first win, and the terms come in writing.

    We're in a code freeze. What do you need from us before December?
    Nothing. Booking touches nothing on your store. The first thing we ask for is five numbers for a December readout, two days before your call, in a form. Planning calls for a January week start on Thu 3 Dec.
    What access do you need, and when?
    For a December readout: five numbers in a form, or GA4 viewer access if you'd rather. No store login and no theme access. For a January launch week: nothing before the planning call. If we take you on, a Slack channel, access to your store and testing tool, and one person who approves designs, from the day the terms are signed. The build goes on a duplicate theme.
    What does it cost?
    The readout and the planning call are free. Your first split test is on us. You pay after the first win. No card on file until then. On the call we tell you what you pay after the first win, and the terms come in writing.
    What does the readout cover?
    Your five Black Friday numbers (sessions, orders, conversion rate, average order value and your top landing page by revenue) beside last year's, where visitors dropped off, and the first three A/B tests we'd run in January, each tied to a number in your readout. It lands in your inbox the day before, so the 15 minutes go on your questions.
    If I pick January, what happens to my first test?
    It is the same first test, and it is still on us. Before the planning call we send the five tests we'd run first on your store, and on the call we pick one together. If we take you on, we design it and build it on a duplicate theme in December or from Mon 4 Jan, and it launches in the week you picked. If it wins, the winning variant goes live and the first invoice follows.

    PurpleFire ApS. Done for you A/B testing for ecommerce brands doing $150k a month or more. Copenhagen, Denmark.

    Results shown are real A/B tests on client stores as recorded in our test log, lift of the winning variant over control on the stated metric. Dollar figures are the revenue difference reported by the testing tool. Your results depend on your traffic, your product and how quickly designs are approved. Payment terms are set out in the agreement signed before work starts.

    Readout template

    Sent the day before; you walk the founder through it on the 15 minute call. A sample outline of what the founder receives:

    PurpleFire readout, sample outline

    {store}: your Black Friday, read back

    Prepared for {first name} on {date}. Black Friday this year Thu 26 Nov to Mon 30 Nov 2026, against Thu 27 Nov to Mon 1 Dec 2025.

    1. Your five numbers.

      A table with Sessions, Orders, Conversion rate, Average order value and Top landing page by revenue, each with This year, Last year and Change.

      NumberThis yearLast yearChange
      Sessions{ }{ }{ }
      Orders{ }{ }{ }
      Conversion rate{ }{ }{ }
      Average order value{ }{ }{ }
      Top landing page by revenue{ }{ }{ }

    2. Where it leaked.

      Two or three plain sentences, each tied to one number above (for example, sessions up and conversion rate down on the top landing page). Written by a person.

    3. Your top landing page.

      One screenshot of the page with one or two notes on what we saw.

      {screenshot}

    4. The first three A/B tests for January.

      For each test: the page, the change, the number in section 1 it targets, the metric we'd read it on, and one result from our log on a comparable brand (public cards, or anonymised and confirmed by Daniel).

    5. The one we'd launch first,

      and why.

    6. Your January week.

      The weeks of Mon 11, Mon 18 and Mon 25 January with seats left from the slot board (2 seats in each week).

    7. The terms.

      Your first split test is on us. You pay after the first win. No card on file until the first winner. What you pay after the first win is told on the call, and the terms come in writing.

    8. Forward line.

      Not the founder? Forward this readout to your founder.

    GHL calendars (two calendars, 15 minutes each, both yours to set up)

    How to useBoth calendars are shared by Funnels 2, 3 and 4; the choice travels in hidden fields and tags, not in the calendar.

    December. Dates: Thu 3 to Fri 18 Dec 2026, weekdays only, 10:00 to 16:00 Copenhagen time, 15 minute slots. Minimum scheduling notice: one working day.

    January. Dates: Tue 5 to Fri 29 Jan 2027, weekdays only, 10:00 to 16:00 Copenhagen time, 15 minute slots. A planning call falls on or before the Friday before its launch week.
